name: pepper-orchestrator
description: Preview: one orchestrator session runs work across several repositories or parallel streams of one repository - plan, work packages, dispatch with worktrees and locks, PR review with a read-only reviewer agent, owner queue, closing a program when its goal is reached, state in files. Start with /pepper-orchestrator:init <program>, then /pepper-orchestrator:plan <task>.

interface.longDescription: Runs work that spans several repositories through one orchestrator session: verified facts, a plan, work packages for module sessions, an owner queue with ready commands, and all state in versioned Markdown files. Irreversible actions stay with the owner.
defaultPrompt: Plan this multi-repository change by the single-orchestrator concept.
